name: The Death of Charles Augustus Milverton
description: Holmes, hired by a society lady to recover compromising letters from the blackmailer Milverton, infiltrates Appledore Towers with Watson. While they hide in the study planning to crack Milverton's safe, an unidentified woman arrives — one of Milverton's previous victims, whose husband had died of grief over letters Milverton sold — and shoots Milverton dead. Holmes and Watson watch from concealment without intervening. They burn Milverton's blackmail archive and escape. The next day, Lestrade asks for Holmes's help identifying the killer; Holmes refuses. The case is one of the few in which Holmes condones (and conceals) a murder, and his refusal is presented without ambiguity as morally correct.
